Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Cummy
Description:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Punchline: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Changelog:
- Other plugins can now build on Cummy: they can read your layers, react when they change, and layer, lick or clean you under your usual rules. They can never change your blocks, mode, blacklist or partners.
- Plugins built on Cummy can send messages to the same plugin on a paired partner's game, over Cummy's hidden tells. Turn this off in Settings, General, Other plugins.
- Plugins can show their own overlays on you (mud, paint...) above your layers, with or without Proteus. They're never saved, and you can see and remove each one, or turn them all off, in Settings, General, Other plugins.
